questions: Should the function preserve leading/trailing spaces on non-empty lines after tab replacement, or should lines be stripped of whitespace before inclusion?
If a line contains only whitespace after tab replacement, should it be excluded? For example, a line with spaces and tabs that become only spaces after replacement.
Should the function handle escaped tab characters (like '\t') in the input string, or only literal tab characters?
What should happen if the input string ends with a newline? Should an empty line at the end be ignored?
Should the function treat all Unicode whitespace characters (e.g., non-breaking spaces) as whitespace for filtering, or only spaces and tabs?
If the input string contains carriage returns (\r) or Windows-style line endings (\r\n), should they be handled as line separators?
Should the function preserve the original order of lines from the input string in the DataFrame?
What should be the data type of the 'Text' column in the DataFrame? Should it always be a string, or could it be something else?
